title: Origins: Slime & Seek
description: A minigame styled after Prop Hunt and built using the Origins mod. Can the Seekers spot the Slimes hiding in plain sight?
body:

**This data pack is designed for the Origins mod. For the best experience, it is highly recommended to also use Pehkui and Mob Origins, though the data pack should still somewhat function without them.**

[This minigame Data Pack was built using a bunch of code from my Pantoslime Origin. If you would like to play an Origin similar to the mechanics shown here, go check out my Pantoslime Origin.](https://modrinth.com/datapack/pantoslime-origin)

This Data Pack differs significantly from the standard Origins Data Pack. I highly recommend you watch the video embedded above to learn how to set it up correctly.

Keep in mind, this minigame is strictly multiplayer and requires some form of server to play. Setting this up with a server host is likely more work than most players will want to do, so I recommend using a mod like [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc), [World Host](https://modrinth.com/mod/world-host), or [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential).

<details>
<summary>🕹️ Player Roles 🕹️</summary>

# Slime

**Your role is to remain unseen. Yet you must fulfill the needs of the slime colony to prevent exposure.**

**🟩 Oozing Mimicry [Primary]:** Your body is mutable clay. Focus on a common interactable object, and your form will ripple into a flawless facsimile. Release your focus, and the disguise melts away into your natural state.

**🟩 Cloak in Stillness [Sneak]:** When wearing a stolen shape, you may still yourself entirely, sinking into the world’s grid like a shadow slipping between cracks. Only the keenest eyes will sense the wrongness in your stillness.

**🟩 Corrosive Touch [Left Click]:** Focus your acidic essence onto a single block, causing it to dissolve instantly. This ability can only be performed once every 30 seconds. Use it to create new hiding spots.

**🟡 Gravity's Paradox:** The ground is your tar and your trampoline. It clings to your every step, yet rewards every leap with a resilient, gravity-defying bounce.

**🔴 Peril of Desiccation:** The seekers wield weapons of pure desiccation, designed to shrivel your mass. A single touch means instantaneous dissolution. Disguise and evasion are your only defense.

**🔴 Slimy Imperative:** Periodically, your kind is driven by a primal need. If no slime fulfills this need, a psychic backlash will ripple through the hive, revealing all of your locations to the hunters.

# Seeker

**Your role is to hunt down and contain the infestation. Complete this goal in time or suffer failure.**

**🟢 Desiccator’s Blade:** Your blade emits a field of rapid desiccation. It is anathema to the slime’s gelatinous biology. A clean strike will instantly dehydrate a mimic, reducing it to an inert stain.

**🟢 Desiccation Launcher:** A ranged instrument that fires concentrated absorbent packets, allowing you to test suspicious objects and eliminate targets from a distance.

**🟢 Keen Senses:** Your hunter's vision pierces the deepest shadows, and your movements are unnervingly swift and powerful. The environment offers you no resistance.

**🟢 Unyielding Form:** You are a warden of order. Even the slimes' pathetic struggles cannot harm you. Your only vulnerability is failure.

**🔴 Sterilization Protocol:** The contagion must be contained within the operational window. If a single slime organism remains undissolved at zero, the area is considered lost to the infestation, and you have failed.

# Spectator

**You cannot interact with the world, nor can it interact with you. Your role is to watch, learn, and await the next round.**

</details>

<details>
<summary>✅ Slimy Imperative Tasks ✅</summary>

**When tasks are assigned to Slimes, one of the following will be assigned at random.**

- Adapt to survive. Change your disguise.
- Admire their colors. Touch a dyeable block.
- Assert your mass. Stop sneaking for 5 seconds.
- Bask under the open sky. Stand outside.
- Comprehend creation. Open a crafting menu.
- Connect to the earth. Touch soil.
- Dissolve the world. Use Corrosive Touch.
- Feel the colony. Stay near a slime for 5 seconds.
- Flow, do not stagnate. Keep moving for 5 seconds.
- Hide from the sky. Go underground or inside.
- Infest their steps. Touch a slab or stair.
- Investigate their hoards. Open a container.
- Know the mountain's bone. Touch stone.
- Pass their barriers. Open some form of door.
- Pulse with energy. Jump 5 times.
- Sample the ancient grove. Touch wood.
- Sate the hive's thirst. Touch water.
- Witness the flame. Open a smelting menu.

</details>

# Start Game

- /function ff_slimeseek:game_start
  - Starts the game with current settings.

# Map Setup

- /function ff_slimeseek:settings/map_setup/set_center
  - Set the center of the world border play space.
- /function ff_slimeseek:settings/map_setup/set_spawn
  - Set the spawn point where players will be placed when the game is started.
- /function ff_slimeseek:settings/map_setup/
  - /function ff_slimeseek:settings/map_setup/map_diameter/25
    - Sets the map world border diameter to 25 blocks.

**By default, the match length is set such that Seekers have 5 minutes to find the Slimes.**

# Seekers Count

**By default, the number of Seekers on game start is 1.**

**Make sure the Seekers count is set to a value below the number of players on the server, or the game will immediately declare the Seekers the victors.**

- /function ff_slimeseek:settings/seeker_count/
  - /function ff_slimeseek:settings/seeker_count/1
    - Sets the game so that it assigns 1 Seeker on game start.

# Slime Tasks

**By default, Slimy Imperative is active.**

- /function ff_slimeseek:settings/slime_tasks/
  - /function ff_slimeseek:settings/slime_tasks/enable
    - Sets Slimy Imperative to be active.
  - /function ff_slimeseek:settings/slime_tasks/disable
    - Sets Slimy Imperative to be inactive.

# ff_slimeseek:z_ignore/

**Do not run any of the commands in this folder; you may likely break something.**
